name: Manastorm: stepping back into the Safety Bubble on an active floor drops combat (#12482)
contract: Issue #12482. The entrance Safety Bubble 93306 is a persistent ground effect the first arrival casts at the
segment's start teleport; its helper 93307 (all-school immunity and MOD_UNATTACKABLE) protects members while
the floor is preparing. Once the floor became active, the validation tick stripped every bubble aura from
every member each second and the ground effect expired with the preparation window, so re-entering the
bubble never dropped aggro as it does on live. Activation now makes the bubble permanent for the floor, and
the active tick ends the combat of a member who steps back within the 8-yard entrance radius while the
bubble stands, then keeps 93307 on them while inside and removes it once they leave again. The member pulls
a Searing Blade Cultist 11322 outside the bubble, is teleported back to the entrance teleport 2040, must be
out of combat with 93307, and loses 93307 after leaving.
